title: GCS-Timer: GPU-Accelerated Current Source Model Based Static Timing Analysis
problem: Static timing analysis using Composite Current Source (CCS) models is computationally expensive and time-consuming despite its accuracy, limiting practical applicability at advanced technology nodes.
motivation: Accurate and efficient static timing analysis is critical for verifying chip designs and meeting performance requirements at advanced nodes.
method: Static timing analysis predicts chip speed by simulating how transistors behave in detail, using CCS models (Composite Current Source models). Normally this detailed simulation requires so many calculations it becomes impractical. GCS-Timer solves this by offloading the simulation to a GPU with thousands of parallel cores that work simultaneously. This maintains detailed accuracy while achieving much faster results—without simplifying the model, which is how other methods usually trade speed for accuracy.
key_novelty: Using GPU parallel processing to accelerate detailed CCS-based circuit timing analysis while maintaining accuracy—without simplifying the model.
contributions: GPU-accelerated algorithm for CCS-based static timing analysis
3.2X speedup compared to 16-threaded industrial standard timer
Improved accuracy without sacrificing model fidelity
primary_theme: GPU acceleration for static timing analysis
